name: Alligator Pie
source:
Alligator Pie is a short, horror visual novel where the difference between motherly love and twisted obsession is only one bad choice away.

[From [url=https://junnii-zee.itch.io/alligator-pie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《鳄鱼派》是一部简短的恐怖视觉小说，其中母爱和扭曲的痴迷之间的区别仅差一个错误的选择。

[来自[url=https://junnii-zee.itch.io/alligator-pie]Itch.io[/url]]
